sources.claim: state-note serializer should reject statuses its paired parser cannot read

sources.head: 8d8132c8f9cabf7ccbde78de41641353652dd48d
sources.claim: accepted offer terms and lock pre-signatures should be snapshotted rather than retained by reference

nonClaims: Neither PR is treated as release-normative until merged/released upstream.
No wire-format, custody, settlement, or state-transition semantics are invented here.

cases.expected: invalid runtime status is rejected before serialization
later mutation of caller-owned offer fields cannot alter accepted snapshot
later mutation of caller-owned presig cannot alter accepted snapshot
later mutation of caller-owned refundAfterMs cannot change a decision based on the accepted snapshot
portable evidence keeps canonical bytes and digest independent of later object mutation
